name: GEF SGP CSO Challenge Program
summary: Global GEF and IUCN programme giving larger grants to civil society organisations that scale or replicate proven environmental solutions, including community-based management of threatened ecosystems and species, through regional calls.

calls.label: 2026 regional calls for proposals
calls.note: Deadlines are announced at the launch of each regional call

status.quote: The deadlines for each regional Call for Proposal will be announced at their official launch.

administered_by.quote: IUCN and the Global Environment Facility (GEF) welcome submission of proposals to the GEF Small Grants Program CSO Challenge Program

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants are local, national, regional, or international civil society organizations (CSOs)

geography.quote: Projects must be implemented in GEF SGP-eligible recipient countries

access.quote: Applications can be submitted https://csochallenge.org/. only through the program website

window.quote: The deadlines for each regional Call for Proposal will be announced at their official launch.

amount.quote: The program provides grant funding of up to $300,000 USD

co_finance_required.quote: Co-funding is not required but is strongly encouraged and strengthens the proposal.
